details.ingredients: Potable Water, Mango Pulp (40%), Sugar, Liquid Glucose, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Emulsifying Agents (INS 471) & Stabilizing Agents (INS 407, 410, 440, 461), Food Colour (INS 110) and Flavour {Nature-Identical & Artificial Flavouring Substances (Mango)}

details.description: Treat yourself to the delightful taste of Cream Bell Vanilla Sandwich Frozen Dessert, featuring a smooth vanilla flavoured medium fat frozen dessert nestled between two crisp chocolate biscuits. The creamy vanilla filling is made with milk solids and offers a rich, satisfying flavour, while the crunchy choco biscuit layers add a delicious contrast in texture. Perfect as a quick dessert, evening snack, or sweet indulgence on a warm day, this frozen sandwich is easy to enjoy anytime. Whether shared with family or savoured on your own, it delivers the classic combination of creamy vanilla and chocolate biscuits in every bite.
details.ingredients:
Inner Layer (56.5%): Potable Water, Sugar, Milk Solids, Edible Vegetable Oil (Refined Palm Oil), Maltodextrin, Emulsifying Agents (INS 433, 471), Stabilizing Agents (INS 407, 410, 412, 466), Flavour (Nature-Identical & Artificial Flavouring Substances (Vanilla)).
Outer Layer (43.5%): Choco Biscuit {Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Refined Palm Oil), Corn Flour, Dextrose Monohydrate, Cocoa Solids, Emulsifier [INS 322(i)], Iodized Salt, Raising Agents [INS 500(i)], Food Colour (INS 150d)}.
